component.name: qbremote
component.summary: Native remote client for qBittorrent's Web UI API

description.p: qbremote controls a remote qBittorrent instance (5.0 or newer) through its Web UI API. It has a desktop-style transfer list, filters, properties panel, search, RSS and options, and never touches torrent data on this computer.
It is an independent project and is not affiliated with the qBittorrent project.
